description: This file defines a middleware component for handling exceptions in an ASP.NET Core application, providing centralized error handling and response serialization.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that intercepts HTTP requests to handle exceptions and produce JSON error responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that invokes the next middleware and catches exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions by setting the appropriate HTTP status code and JSON error message.
